trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.caution: The risk in this set is timing, not the story’s end: one race inside Yago’s strand is a timed hourglass mission that can vanish if left sitting. Make a manual save and run it the moment it appears. [3]
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida — but not every strand counts, and the game never tells you which ones do. Only four counting strands are confirmed so far: Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete. The method that keeps this silver honest is to watch the trophy counter before and after every strand finale and bank your eight from confirmed strands first. Nothing here is missable — strands persist after the story — but one timed mission inside Yago’s strand can expire, so treat that one as urgent. [3]
steps: Check the counter here before and after each strand finale — only some strands advance it, and the game never says which. [3]

Kirk (Chapter 1): “Have you seen Skunk Ape?” flyers around Key Lento start the strand — call Kirk, then meet him in the evening in Pelican Valley near Thorp Adventures. Three missions, including a Mr. Mangrove hunt near Cottonmouth Lake; some trigger only at night. [3]
Kyle (Chapter 2): his flyer starts a crop-duster strand at McKittrick Farm — dust the strawberry fields, then answer his later chemical-collection call; the finale, “Buddy?”, lands in Chapter 3. [3]
Yago (Chapter 3): street races out of Salton. One race is a timed hourglass mission — manual save first and run it the moment it appears, because timed missions can vanish. [3]
Pilot Pete (Chapter 4, Jason only): call him and head to Sundown Airfield in Leonard County — five missions, dropping from the Wild Hog, Southpoint, Kelly and Leonard airfields. [3]

Do not count on Billy, Andy, Tyrone, Shirley, Moses, Yasmani or Eddie Acosta: their strands do not advance this trophy, and several end in trophies of their own. Bret, Tyrone and Pilot Pete are Jason-only, as are two of Yago’s missions; Andy is Lucia-only. [3]
The other four counting strands are still unconfirmed — verify the counter after every finale until your eight are banked. Strands otherwise persist into post-story free roam. [2] [3]

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.missableNote: Disputed: the Chapter 1 balcony meditation is permanently unavailable once Chapter 1 ends, and there is no mission replay. Whether it is required for 18/18 is unconfirmed; both sourced versions are shown below. Do it in Chapter 1 either way.

dispute.a: GameTrek: the balcony session IS one of the 18 and is effectively required — accept it immediately, in Chapter 1.
dispute.b: PowerPyx: unconfirmed. The balcony raises the counter by 1 but is not marked a Meditation Spot, and the final meditation may count +2 — so skipping it might still reach 18/18. Untested either way.
dispute.check: Roadmap check — PowerPyx’s Trophy Guide & Roadmap counts this as the game’s potentially 1 missable trophy [2].
dispute.call: Same move either way: accept the balcony meditation in Chapter 1. It costs a minute and removes the only real risk on this list.

trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 meditations, but only 10 locations. Most spots count once per character: meditate at the same spot as Jason and again as Lucia and each session adds +1, which is how 10 places make 18. Both characters are playable from Chapter 2’s “Coffee Break” on. The 100% checklist needs only 15 of the 18; this trophy needs all 18 — including one Chapter 1 session that can never be repeated, which is why this is the list’s one possibly missable trophy. [1] [4]
steps: Chapter 1, the morning after “Down to Earth”: Lucia announces a meditation in Jason’s kitchen and walks to the balcony. Follow her, talk, and Accept — +1, and she teaches the breathing meditation. It is gone for good once Chapter 1 ends. [1] [2] [4]

Track the hunt under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations, and filter the map by Exploration > “Meditate Around Leonida” — unvisited spots show as purple icons when you are near one. [1]

Work the eight open-world spots with BOTH characters (8 × 2 = 16): Smooth Sand, the sandbar west of Capri (Mariana County); the Swamp dock by the lookout tower in Buckskin Swamp and Worn Stone on the Emerald River bank at Camp Moonflower (Kelly County); Red Rocks, where the train tracks cross the highway in Manifest Canyon (Kelly County); the Water Wheel at the ruined paper mill on a river south of Moreau, the Jutting Cliff tower overlooking a mine in Mount Kalaga National Park, and the Waterfall north-west of Tallaloko (Lummox County); and Seaside, the rocky outcrop east of Waning Sands (Leonard County). [1] [4]
Finish at Ascent Mountain: the stone circle at Mount Kalaga’s peak is marked on the map only once all the others are done — that single meditation is the 18th. [4]
Efficient order: the Kelly County trio together, then the Lummox County trio, Ascent Mountain last. Log every session in the counter here — per character, not per place. [4]

trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. The conditions are precise: your partner must be with you, the wanted level must reach 4 stars, and you must then lose it completely. Set it up deliberately — raise the heat together somewhere with a clean escape route, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the stars clear.
